text: {"lessons":["Because past price changes do not predict future ones, I should avoid reacting to short-term account fluctuations and make deliberate decisions.","Selling Stock D and E at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell merely to lock in a profit; I should weigh each holding against its future prospects and my overall plan.","I should not let the pain of losses or reluctance to admit a mistake prevent me from reassessing a position objectively."]}
